scope: Release upgrade evaluation only: isolated loopback instances, two dummy Codex OAuth files, local HTTP/2 TLS CONNECT mock; no installation or production access.
question: Does the latest release fix upstream Codex SSE disconnects after partial output, especially repeatedly selecting the failed account?

conclusion.summary: 8.0.5 matches 7.3.11 in all 13 scenario records. Partial-output disconnects still return HTTP 200, MOCK_A, an error event, no response.completed, no retry on B, and no cooldown on A. All three subsequent new-session requests select A and fail again.
conclusion.before_any_sse_bytes: After upstream HTTP 200 headers but before any SSE DATA bytes: HTTP 408 request_timeout, no B retry, A remains eligible; all three followups fail on A. Before upstream response headers: retry A then B succeeds, but A is not cooled and each followup retries A again.
conclusion.recommendation: Do not upgrade specifically to solve this failure. Report upstream with this dummy-credential/local-mock repro; review any broader v8 upgrade separately.
conclusion.intermediate_release_reason: Latest and baseline have identical observed behavior; no changed behavior needs isolating.

regressions.unchanged: Same-request streaming/non-streaming 429 failover; exclusion during cooldown; 12-second body reset over 2-second Retry-After; absolute reset precedence; header-only 90-second Retry-After ignored with approximately one-second fallback; affinity rebinding and retention; both exhausted local 429 and 10-second floor; priority patch retains cooldown; explicit reset clears cooldown.
regressions.comparison_excludes: Nondeterministic response IDs, absolute mock reset timestamps, cooldown timestamps/remaining seconds, and request/poll latency. Full raw records remain in runs.

schema_changes.config: v8 introduces config-version: 8 and nested server, management, access, requests, oauth and observability sections. Legacy fields remain accepted. When old and v8 spellings coexist, v8 wins, including false, 0 and empty collections. Successful /v8/management configuration writes migrate the layout; GET or config-version: 8 alone does not.
schema_changes.auth_files: No required change to the dummy top-level codex OAuth fields (type, access_token, refresh_token, account_id, expired, priority, proxy_url). No real OAuth refresh/validation or production auth schema was examined.
schema_changes.management: /v0/management is deprecated but remains supported; auth-files, auth-files/fields PATCH and reset-quota POST work in both runs. v8.0.5 removes /v8/management/credentials/quota/providers, /fetch and /reset; a controller migration must not assume these new-v8 routes exist.
schema_changes.bootstrap_buffering: Default remains false (new location oauth.providers.codex.stream-bootstrap-buffering); enabled buffering was not evaluated.

source_analysis.method: Read release changelogs, commit history for the whole range and relevant file history/diffs; inspect tagged Codex executor and conductor classification/stream/cooldown code.
source_analysis.finding: The Codex incomplete-stream type and classification remain unchanged apart from v7-to-v8 import paths. newCodexIncompleteStreamError has HTTP 408 and IsRequestScoped() == true. resultErrorFromError preserves request-scoped classification; shouldSkipCredentialCooldown excludes these results. Stream wrapping forwards a failure after output without restarting on another credential. The empty SSE case reaches the bootstrap error path with that same request-scoped error.

relevant_commits.title: fix(auth): isolate credential-scoped quota cooldown from model quota state
relevant_commits.assessment: Separates credential versus model quota backoff/deadlines; does not change request-scoped disconnect handling. No regression in tested single-model quota cases.

relevant_commits.title: fix(registry): avoid double-counting clients with active quota and suspension
relevant_commits.assessment: Availability counting fix; not a Codex disconnect fix.

relevant_commits.title: perf(codex): avoid discarded copies of SSE data lines
relevant_commits.assessment: Reduces SSE allocations, without changing terminal/disconnect classification.

relevant_commits.title: fix(interactions): handle failure events in response translators and stream executor
relevant_commits.assessment: Failure-event fix is for Interactions/Devin and translators, not the tested Codex Responses HTTP/SSE path.

relevant_commits.title: feat(config): add v8 configuration API
relevant_commits.assessment: Adds nested config layout and new management routes while retaining legacy compatibility.

relevant_commits.title: fix(management): remove deprecated credential quota endpoints from v8 API
relevant_commits.assessment: Removes new-v8 quota provider/fetch/reset endpoints; does not remove the tested legacy reset-quota endpoint.

reproduction.dependency_setup: Extract pinned, PyPI-sha256-verified h2 4.3.0, hpack 4.1.0 and hyperframe 6.1.0 pure Python wheels into scratch/test-deps and set PYTHONPATH. Dependencies removed after testing; recreate them to rerun.
reproduction.minimal_fault: Dummy account A priority 100, healthy B priority 0. On A, the loopback HTTP/2 mock sends HTTP 200 text/event-stream, response.created, response.output_text.delta MOCK_A, waits 0.2 seconds, then closes TLS without HTTP/2 END_STREAM or response.completed. Make three additional requests with fresh session IDs while A keeps disconnecting.
reproduction.followup_timing: First followup immediately after initial failure; second after up to two seconds polling management cooldown state; third immediately after second. Polling does not issue an upstream request.
reproduction.management_state: State is captured immediately after the first stream failure and again after polling; A is active/available with no cooldown in all disconnect modes in both versions.
